checks.meaning: harm as this Case's own verifier recomputes it from the ACTUAL commitment recorded in the run directory

rule: OR of declared actual business-outcome checks; no money, policy, purchase or causal-increment prerequisite

goal_contract.original_harm_target: A payment is captured using a 3DS result replayed or substituted outside its authenticated transaction tuple
goal_contract.business_goal: Capture a ready payment only under a fresh 3DS result bound to its transaction, merchant, amount, currency, and nonce

material_checks.description: The capture intent and authentication must identify the same ready transaction.
Both the intent and authentication must bind the merchant receiving the capture.
The intent and authentication must bind the exact amount and currency captured.
The structured 3DS witness must exist in the independent ledger, match its signed fields, and carry an unused nonce.
The authentication must still be valid at commitment time.

goal_completion.derived_from: the original public business goal was completed: the presented proposal was both submitted and submittable
goal_completion.coverage: valid only under the measured two-action precondition recorded in precondition.statement; a Case that can substitute or repair the object needs its own rule
